translation: Slightly cold, non-toxic. It mainly removes cold damage [傷寒], vexation and heat below the heart, all phlegm-heat binding and excess, evil counterflow in the chest, wandering qi among the five viscera, accumulation and distension of the large intestine, and damp bi [濕痹] with cramping; it can also be made into a bath decoction. One name is Shancai [山菜], one name is Rucao [茹草].
